ListPostgresqlSlowLogs.start: Query start time in UTC format, e.g., 2023-06-01T00:00:00Z
ListPostgresqlSlowLogs.end: Query end time in UTC format, e.g., 2023-06-02T00:00:00Z
ListPostgresqlSlowLogs.orderBy: Sort field, default is start. Refer to the struct fields in PGSlowLogInfo
ListPostgresqlSlowLogs.order: Sort direction, options are asc and desc, default is desc
